content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task manager","i_want":"to create a new task with its required fields","so_that":"I can record work I need to track","business_description":"Users create tasks that are stored with a unique ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date, Due Date, Last Updated Date and Completion Date. The backend rejects tasks with an empty title or a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date. The frontend shows success only after the backend confirms the save. This story covers create only; editing is handled by US-update-task.","business_value":"Users can record tasks reliably, and invalid tasks are stopped before they are stored, so later views, updates form","when":"The user submits the form with an empty title","then":"The backend rejects the task, no task is stored, and the form shows an error message that names the Title field as mandatory"},{"given":"A user opens the task creation form and the backend receives the request on 2024-05-10","when":"The user submits a Due Date of 2024-05-09","then":"The backend rejects the task with an error stating that the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date, and no task is stored"},{"given":"A user opens the task creation form and the backend receives the request on 2024-05-10","when":"The user submits a Due Date of 2024-05-10","then":"The backend accepts the task because the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date"},{"given":"A create request with a Status value outside Open, In Progress and Completed, or a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High","when":"The request is sent to the backend","then":"The backend rejects the task, no task is stored, and the form shows an error message"},{"given":"A create request has been accepted and the task is stored","when":"The stored task is read from the database","then":"The task has the fields ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date, Due Date, Last Updated Date and Completion Date, and Completion Date is empty"},{"given":"A create request is accepted","when":"The backend
